# RusherCrypt

**Category:** Misc  
**Aliases:** RusherCrypt

## What it does

Encrypt and Decrypt chat messages that users with Decrypt online can see

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/RusherCrypt.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
